Hi, Watson.
When I was calculating random graphs controlling for clustering using the customized Brainnetome atlas (210 brain regions), I encountered the same problem as Gershon Spitz (https://groups.google.com/g/braingraph-help/c/RcXCcA49Tzs/m/J88Tl-grBgAJ):
Error in { : task 1 failed - "object 'NA' not found".
I tried the solutions you provided to  Spitz, but I still got the same error message.
Any help would be greatly appreciated.
Thank you！
